quote: In Q2 2024, the St. Vincent and the Grenadines Port Authority (SVGPA) ordered a Konecranes Gottwald ESP.7 Mobile Harbor Crane to boost container and general cargo handling capacity in the Port of Kingstown. This new Generation 6 machine will join their existing Konecranes Gottwald mobile harbor crane in a new terminal, opening in Q1 2025 … The Konecranes Gottwald ESP.7 Mobile Harbor Crane has a working radius of up to 51 m and a maximum capacity of 125 t
note: Opened Konecranes English release 14 Aug 2024 (Kingstown ESP.7 Q2 2024 order).
